rows.label: HamStudy HamBook — glossary of amateur radio terms
rows.note: A free study guide with a full glossary. Licensed CC BY-NC-ND, which permits sharing it as published — so Elmer links to it rather than copying its definitions.

rows.label: RepeaterBook — Pinellas County repeaters
rows.note: Elmer does not hold repeater listings. RepeaterBook's data is licensed, so we point you at the people who maintain it rather than keeping a copy that would go stale.

rows.label: RadioReference — Florida amateur radio database
rows.note: A second source for repeater listings, kept by the people who maintain it.

rows.label: ARRL — find an exam session
rows.note: The ARRL VEC has no public API, so exam sessions are searched at the source. Ask your local club too — they often run sessions that are easier to book.
